sources.title: Geometric Skinning with Approximate Dual Quaternion Blending
sources.alternate_copy_byte_identity: Not certified identical to the hashed Utah copy.
sections: Physical12–13:4.1–4.2 selected sign and nonrigid discussion
supports: Weighted rigid matrices need not remain rigid; normalized weights alone do not prevent contraction.
Normalized dual-quaternion blending handles rigid transforms; nonrigid scale/shear requires separate handling.
Shortest-path switching can create shape discontinuity near a half-turn.
sources.reading_scope: Targeted sections, not full-paper or appendix reading. Main editor visually checked physical15 Figure20; independent review used its text. No video or linked implementation execution.
limitations: Historical performance figures are not adopted as modern platform measurements.
No universal volume, visual quality or scale/shear support promise.
